title: Explorer action
responsibility: Renders a button or real navigation link with optional icons.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.href
inputs.description: Optional address. Nonempty and enabled renders an anchor; otherwise a button.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.onclick
inputs.description: Optional handler. For links, only plain clicks are intercepted; other clicks remain native. Buttons invoke it directly if supplied.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.disabled
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True renders a disabled button even when href exists.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.tone
inputs.description: Optional gold or plain styling, default gold.

outputs.name: HarnessAction
outputs.description: Styled action with leading/trailing icons at size 18. Buttons have type button. Handler failures are not caught.
